_comment: What each lane owes, and when. Read by tools/lane-heartbeat.mjs, which the CoS desk runs every weekday. Written 2026-09-22 after the Sep 21 X Desk Watch filing went missing and nobody noticed until Mo asked a question that depended on it — the CoS desk's own condition (2) says a stalled loop must be visible in minutes, not days, and nothing was actually checking. NOTE the filings live in the claude.ai PROJECT, not the repo: these lanes hold no push credential by design, so a repo-side check can never see them. The heartbeat takes the Project's doc list and diffs it against what was due. | 2026-09-29 desk: R15 rule 4 — Site Sweep, Growth League and X Daily added (they started Sep 27-29 and were never entered); Integrity Watch and the Ideas Desk moved to daily per GO-TIME. The Night Crew files log-<night date>.md after midnight, which this tool's same-day date arithmetic cannot express; it is checked by hand in the desk entry until the tool learns an offset. | 2026-10-09 desk: R33 cadence (X Desk Watch + Integrity Watch Mon/Thu, Ideas Desk + Site Sweep Tue/Fri) and the Retention Desk (Sun-Thu, from Oct 11, R34) written in; the Oct 9 heartbeat read two Friday "misses" that were the old daily rows.

lanes.name: X Desk Watch (@shopcardhub feed + CoS queue)
lanes.why: the only check on the vendor's feed; a silent day is a day nobody read what went public
lanes.cadenceNote: R33 (Oct 8): Mon/Thu. days = JS getDay() numbers (0 Sun). Run --since no earlier than 2026-10-08 or pre-R33 daily slots read as misses.

lanes.name: Integrity Watch (instruments and claims)
lanes.why: catches a published number drifting from its source
lanes.cadenceNote: R33 (Oct 8): Mon/Thu. days = JS getDay() numbers (0 Sun). Run --since no earlier than 2026-10-08 or pre-R33 daily slots read as misses.

lanes.name: Earnings Ideas Desk
lanes.why: the only lane whose job is finding money
lanes.cadenceNote: R33 (Oct 8): Tue/Fri. days = JS getDay() numbers (0 Sun). Run --since no earlier than 2026-10-08 or pre-R33 daily slots read as misses.

lanes.name: Site Sweep — bugs + UX
lanes.why: the daytime independent check on every sitemap page (R24/R28); a silent day is a day no one looked
lanes.cadenceNote: R33 (Oct 8): Tue/Fri. days = JS getDay() numbers (0 Sun). Run --since no earlier than 2026-10-08 or pre-R33 daily slots read as misses.

lanes.name: Growth League (board + builds)
lanes.why: R27's scoring lane; the board is the only read of the league pages

lanes.name: X Daily Posts (CoS-approved)
lanes.why: the X queue's fact trail; X Desk Watch grades posts against it

lanes.name: Retention Desk (reasons to return)
lanes.why: the only lane that invents reasons for a collector to come back (R34); its rows must be ruled by the desk
